sceneAnchors: Your body is lying in a room which has no outside.
You were still yourself. More of yourself than you had ever been before.
Why must I pretend the pleasure was a warning? It was good. Whatever happened afterward, it was good.
It is worse than a prophecy. A prophecy could be wrong without taking anything away from you.
The demand is ludicrous and immense. You can feel yourself preparing an argument for it.
You taste the white fruit and begin to cry before you know whether you are afraid.
